title: ITSM Maturity Scan
lead: A structured assessment of IT service management maturity — baseline input for ITSM operating model design.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: The ITSM Maturity Scan evaluates the current state of IT service management processes, tools and governance. It benchmarks process maturity against recognised frameworks (ITIL, ISO/IEC 20000) and identifies improvement opportunities. The output is a maturity heatmap and a prioritised improvement roadmap.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: The ITSM Maturity Scan is typically the first step in an ITSM operating model redesign. It establishes a factual baseline, aligns stakeholders on the current state and prioritises the improvements needed to achieve the target operating model.

items.desc: Coverage and effectiveness of core ITSM processes (incident, change, problem, etc.).
Fitness of the ITSM tooling (ServiceNow, Topdesk, etc.) for current needs.
Accountability, escalation paths and service reporting.
Roles, competencies and training levels across the IT organisation.
Service quality perception from business stakeholders.
